name: invoicelite
idea: InvoiceLite is a free, browser-only invoice generator that lets freelancers and small businesses create, customize, and download professional PDF invoices in seconds — no sign-up, no account, no data ever leaves the browser.
why_trending: The global gig economy surpassed 1.5 billion workers in 2026 and 'free invoice generator' is one of the highest-volume commercial-intent search queries in the productivity tools category (estimated 100K+ monthly US searches). Multiple incumbents (InvoiceMaker, Invoice Ninja, FreshBooks) charge $10–30/month, leaving a large audience actively searching for a free alternative — confirmed by micro-SaaS trend reports from May/June 2026 showing solopreneurs as the #1 underserved segment for lightweight billing utilities.
why_profitable: Monetizes via Google AdSense display ads targeting a high-value finance/business audience (CPMs of $8–15), plus a future 'Pro' one-time purchase ($9) unlocking custom logo uploads, multiple color themes, and persistent client history — a proven freemium pattern used by PDF utility tools with 5–7% paid conversion rates. Affiliate commissions from QuickBooks and FreshBooks referrals add a passive revenue layer.
why_easy: 100% static HTML/CSS/JS — all invoice logic runs client-side with vanilla JS. jsPDF (loaded from cdnjs CDN) renders a branded, accent-colored PDF with one function call. LocalStorage persists invoice history across sessions. The share-link feature base64-encodes full invoice state into the URL query string for serverless sharing. No database, no auth, no build step — deployable to GitHub Pages as a single index.html.
